theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_cone_set_graph_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (G : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (lam A : ℝ), (∀ x, ∃ v w, x = ι v + ι' w) → (∀ v w, T₀.starProjection (ι v + ι' w) = ι v) → 0 ≤ lam → lam ≤ 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ A → (∀ y₁ ∈ G, ∀ y₂ ∈ G, ‖(y₂ - y₁) - T₀.starProjection (y₂ - y₁)‖ ≤ lam * ‖y₂ - y₁‖) → (∀ y ∈ G, ‖(y - ξ) - T₀.starProjection (y - ξ)‖ ≤ A) → ∃ f : Euclid n → Euclid k, (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt k * lam * ‖v - w‖) ∧ (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt k * A) ∧ G ⊆ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v))
